g.text: GHCR is a proposal pending B review.
pre-deploy and rollback must be verified.
Do not enable a second deployment path bypassing CI.
Only Web has a public HTTPS domain.
API and PostgreSQL have no public TCP endpoint.
must be agreed and implemented before delivery.
PROPOSED — no A2 production deployment is claimed.
A2 Dockerfiles and pipeline are not yet implemented at baseline d0a92b9.
Local: separate A2 checkout/config/database; Compose is local only.
CI: isolated test database, no production DB access during image build.
Production: dedicated A2 services, secrets and persistent volume.
A1 Compose evidence is reference only.
